decisions.reason: The availability-payment sizing targets do not change the debt-equity structure, debt cost, or mezzanine treatment; the source message's separate financing decision is already represented.
Sizing availability payments against DSCR and equity IRR does not change the capex estimate or cost composition; the separate shared-cost decision from the same message is already represented.
The sizing targets use financial-model outputs but do not change the operating-cost range or assumption basis; the source message's separate opex decision is already represented.
The DSCR and equity-IRR sizing criteria do not change the authoritative site list; the separate site-list decision from the same message is already represented.
The quantitative sizing criteria support the existing availability-payment justification but do not necessarily change the narrative's audience, purpose, or communication-quality requirements.
The availability-payment targets do not alter the requirement to annotate assumptions or use the supplied materials as reference sources.
The new sizing criteria become model inputs or constraints but do not change the existing requirements for data review, error checking, or modeling quality.
Adding DSCR and equity-IRR targets to availability-payment sizing does not change the model's presentation-quality requirement.
